terms.title: TERMS OF USE
terms.subtitle: Ola social network
terms.notice: This is a sample terms document for learning / research purposes, not an official legal document.

blocks.text: By creating an account and using the Ola application/social network ("Ola", "we", "the service"), you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to comply with all of the content in these Terms of Use, as well as the rules and guidelines published alongside them. If you do not agree with any term, please do not register or stop using the service.
We may update or amend these terms from time to time. Your continued use of the service after the terms are updated means you accept those changes.

items: You must be 13 or older to create an account. If you are under 18, you need the consent/supervision of a parent or legal guardian.
Registration information (username, password…) must be accurate, must not violate good morals, and must not impersonate another individual/organization.
Each person should own only one account and is responsible for keeping login information secure as well as for all activity arising from the account.
If you detect unauthorized access to your account, please change your password and contact us immediately.
We have the right to refuse, temporarily lock or terminate accounts that violate the terms without prior notice.

blocks.text: When using Ola (posting, commenting, chatting, setting names/statuses, community rooms…), you must not:

items: Post pornographic or violent content, content that discriminates by race/religion/gender, incites hatred, or violates Vietnamese law;
Harass, threaten, bully, or insult the honor and dignity of others;
Spread false information, fraud, spam, unauthorized advertising, or malicious links;
Impersonate other people, organizations, or state agencies;
Use automated software/tools (bots) or exploit system bugs for profit or to harm the shared experience;
Buy, sell or trade accounts or virtual items (KEN, VIP…) with real money outside the official channels provided by Ola.

blocks.text: Violating content may be removed; the accounts involved may be warned, temporarily locked or permanently terminated depending on severity.

You retain ownership of the content (posts, images, messages, statuses…) that you upload. However, by uploading it to Ola, you grant us the right to store, display and back up that content to the extent necessary to operate and improve the service.
You undertake that the content you upload does not infringe the intellectual property or privacy rights of any third party, and you take legal responsibility for the content you create.

sections.title: 5. Virtual items and in-app currency (KEN, VIP…)

items: KEN, VIP and other virtual items/currencies in Ola are not real money, have no cash-conversion value, and are only usable within the application.
Topping up/purchasing KEN or virtual items (if any) is a voluntary transaction; we are not responsible for real-money trades between users outside the official system.
We have the right to adjust, suspend or terminate any virtual items/features at any time to ensure stable and fair operation.
Violating accounts (fraud, bug exploitation, illegal trading…) may have their virtual items revoked and/or the account locked without refund.

blocks.text: We collect some necessary information (username, recovery email if you provide one, usage data…) in order to operate, secure and improve the service. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

Private messages and chat content are stored to serve the application's features and are only accessed in cases necessary to operate the service, troubleshoot incidents, or upon the request of a competent state authority as required by law.

Ola is provided "as is" and may experience interruptions, technical errors or scheduled maintenance. We strive to keep the service stable but do not absolutely guarantee continuity or freedom from errors.
We are not responsible for damage arising from: the behavior of other users, content uploaded by users, data loss due to faults in your device/connection, or force-majeure events.

You may stop using the service at any time. We have the right to temporarily lock or terminate an account if we detect violations of the terms or behavior harmful to the system or the user community, even without prior notice, in order to protect the common interest.
For any feedback, reports or complaints relating to your account, content or the terms of use, please contact us via Ola's support email.

download.title: Get the Ola app
download.subtitle: Install Ola on your phone for instant message alerts, voice calls and smoother games.
download.loginLink: Get the Ola app for your phone
download.inAppTitle: Please open in Chrome or Safari
download.inAppMessage: Browsers inside Facebook, Messenger or Zalo usually block file downloads. Copy the link and paste it into Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone) to get the app.
download.openOnPhone: Open this page on your phone
download.openOnPhoneHint: You are on a computer. Type the address below into your phone browser to download the app.

android.name: Android
steps: Tap “Open the APK folder” to open the Ola folder on Google Drive, pick the newest APK file (about 56 MB, Wi-Fi recommended), then tap the download icon.
Chrome warns “This type of file can harm your device” — choose “Download anyway”.
Open the downloaded file. If your phone says installing unknown apps is not allowed, tap “Settings” and allow installs from Chrome or your file manager.
Play Protect may show “Unknown app” — choose “Install anyway”.
Wait for the install to finish, then open Ola and sign in.
android.note: These warnings are normal for APK files installed outside Google Play. The build on this page is published by us.
android.linkHint: Paste this link into Chrome if the button above does not work.

ios.name: iPhone / iPad
ios.installTestflight: Install TestFlight from the App Store
steps: Install Apple TestFlight from the App Store (free). TestFlight is Apple own app for trying builds before they reach the App Store; if it asks you to sign in, use your iCloud account.
Open TestFlight for the first time and tap “Continue” on the “Welcome to TestFlight” screen.
Come back to this page, tap “Open TestFlight invite”, then tap “Install” on the Ola - Chat page inside TestFlight.
On the “From the developer” screen, tap “Next”.
On the “Share feedback” screen, tap “Start Testing”.
Ola opens up — sign in with your account and you are done.
ios.note: Each TestFlight build stays valid for 90 days. When it expires, open TestFlight and update to the latest build.
ios.codeHint: Open TestFlight → Redeem → paste this code if the invite link will not open.

faq.question: Nothing happens when I tap download?
faq.answer: You are viewing this page in the Facebook or Zalo in-app browser, which blocks downloads. Copy the page link and open it in Chrome or Safari.

faq.question: My phone refuses to install apps from unknown sources?
faq.answer: Go to Settings → Apps → pick the browser you downloaded with → turn on “Allow app installs from this source”, then open the APK again.

faq.question: Play Protect says the app may be harmful?
faq.answer: That is the default warning for any APK installed outside Google Play, so choose “Install anyway”. Just make sure you downloaded the file from the link shown on this page.

faq.question: The APK link fails or will not download?
faq.answer: The APK is hosted on Google Drive, which can temporarily block downloads when too many people fetch it at once. Try again in a few minutes, or tap “Open the Google Drive folder” and pick the newest APK file yourself.

faq.question: TestFlight says the invite is full or expired?
faq.answer: Tester slots are limited. Try again later, or use the web version while you wait.

faq.question: How do I update the app?
faq.answer: Android: download the new APK from this page and install it over the old one — your data stays. iPhone: open TestFlight and tap Update.

faq.question: Will installing the app lose my account data?
faq.answer: No. Messages and account details are stored on Ola servers, so everything is there on any device you sign in from.

download.safetyTitle: Only download Ola from the official site
download.safety: Ola will never ask you to download an installer from a stranger message, a Zalo group or Facebook. Files from other sources can be repackaged with malware to take over your account.
